title: Receipt state machine: 'read' then 'delivered' path has no test
description: ReceiptHandler handles 'delivered' (update_delivery_state) and 'read' (update_read_at) as distinct operations on different columns. The 'read' then 'delivered' forward-progress path (read_at set first, then delivery_state=delivered) is not tested. The code allows it (update_delivery_state WHERE delivery_state != 'delivered' does not block a pending→delivered transition after read_at is set), but no test verifies the state counter advances correctly on both calls and that delivered_at is set on the second call. — Add a unit test in kith-peer integration suite: send 'read' receipt first, assert read_at set and delivery_state unchanged; send 'delivered' receipt second, assert delivery_state=delivered and delivered_at set and counter advanced twice.
